capture: TIM4 PB6 and TIM3 PA6 CH1 BOTHEDGE input capture interrupts; B PB7/PA7 direction only
units: raw signed A edges in non-overlapping 50ms windows, no rpm/distance conversion or artificial count multiplier
sequence: IDLE -> PD0 release -> forward each wheel 2000 -> both settled -> 2000ms pause -> reset per-segment global counters -> reverse each wheel 2000 -> both settled -> STOPPED brake hold. Does not loop.
globals: g_motor_pulses[2], direction-normalized segment displacement; phase stopped freezes values; signed sampler remains active
controller: position-form absolute PWM FF + Kp*error + Kd*filtered error difference + bounded count synchronization; no I; initial feedforward, not real-car tuned
smoothing: 500ms smoothstep start; last400 counts smoothstep reference50->20; normal drive PWM step <=0.06 duty each50ms. Endpoint threshold and emergency stop brake immediately, no reverse correction.
display: 12x24 font: raw A edges/50ms, signed PWM percent, each wheel segment total. No A high/low state.
counting_change: Old TI12 x4 -> A-only x2, half old quadrature counts at same travel, twice A single-edge counts. Counter polarity assumes previous inverted-A direction; verify first run.
tests: test_a50.c software tests; physical edge capture, speed stability, overshoot and return location remain unverified
